faceCheck20261113.result: 667 areas pixelated in 91 photos, including one car licence plate and three on-screen names.

presenterCheck20261113.rule: Every real person's face is pixelated, now including people presenting (microphone, podium, panel seat, MC) and photographs of real people shown on screens or slides. presenterCheck20261113.scope: 200 wall photos: the 60 where presenters had been left were re-read by eye, a face detector was run over the final version of all 200, and four independent reviewers re-read the 60 as 2x tiles.
